FN-HGKGP36-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 279
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/07/2025
Senate Bill 279 as introduced would authorize the Legislative Council to contract for the
demolition of the current Alabama State House upon completion of construction of the new
Alabama State House. This would increase the expenditures of the Legislative Council, paid
from the General Fund by an undetermined amount. However, the increased expenditures would
be offset partially by any funds received from the disposition of any property or materials part of
or affixed to the current Alabama State House pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-HGKGP36-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 279
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/25/2025
Senate Bill 279 as passed the Senate would authorize the Legislative Council to contract for the
demolition of the current State House which would increase the obligations of the Legislature by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of such contract.
This bill could also increase receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of any funds received from the sale of certain items from the current
State House.
